title: $31.5 million disclosed cash purchase consideration ($29.388M net cash outflow)
summary: AHS’s audited statements report $31.5 million cash purchase consideration for acquiring DynaLIFE operations on August 31, 2023, after settling $16.295 million in balances due from DynaLIFE. The same transaction appears as $29.388 million net cash outflow after cash acquired. The legal cash payee and owner-level distribution are unverified.
attribution: Alberta Health Services audited 2023–24 annual report

title: Dispute over records access during the Auditor General examination
summary: The Auditor General said AHS restricted access to records with Department of Health support and that the impact of missing or redacted material was indeterminate. Premier Smith told the Assembly the government fully cooperated and disputed suggestions otherwise. The available records do not establish personal intent behind the access limits.
attribution: Auditor General of Alberta; Premier Danielle Smith in Hansard

title: AHS board term-sheet approval and conditional CEO delegation
summary: AHS’s board unanimously approved AHS and APL entering a DynaLIFE term sheet on January 27, 2022 and conditionally delegated CEO authority to execute a later services agreement if its final fundamental terms were not substantively different. The Auditor General separately reports board approval of the contract based on value. The final condition and signatories remain unverified.
attribution: AHS Board minutes; Auditor General of Alberta

title: Absence of a documented formal business case (OAG finding)
summary: The Auditor General found no evidence that AHS or Alberta Health developed a formal business case before initiating the procurement. This is an audit finding subject to the auditor’s stated indeterminate access limitation, not proof that no other analysis existed.

title: $77 million auditor-estimated extra cost for 2019–23 initiative
summary: The Auditor General estimated about $61 million in incremental cost against an estimated continuation of the prior service model over roughly eight months, plus $16 million to reintegrate services, producing $77 million for the 2019–23 initiative. These are audit-assessed additional costs, not gross payments to DynaLIFE.

title: AHS and Premier Smith rationale for outsourcing and reversal
summary: AHS described improving service delivery as the purpose of bringing DynaLIFE operations under APL in 2023. The Auditor General reports that savings were the primary earlier objective of outsourcing. Premier Smith later said her government reversed course after seeing DynaLIFE could not manage provincewide service.
attribution: AHS; Auditor General of Alberta; Premier Danielle Smith in Hansard

title: Ministerial and department strategic direction (OAG finding)
summary: The Auditor General found that the then health minister and Department of Health expected the 2019–22 community laboratory outsourcing to proceed, while AHS management and board were not the strategic decision-makers. This finding does not attribute initiation to Danielle Smith.

title: $4.8 billion estimated initial commitment (cancelled August 31, 2023)
summary: AHS reported executing the services and ancillary agreements on May 30, 2022, with an estimated $4.8 billion commitment over an initial 14 years and four months. The related commitment ended on August 31, 2023. This was a prospective contract estimate, not cash paid.
attribution: Alberta Health Services audited annual reports

title: Written RFP met standards; Sonic withdrew citing pandemic travel limits
summary: The Auditor General found the written RFP met applicable document standards. After Sonic Healthcare withdrew citing pandemic travel restrictions, an independent procurement adviser said AHS could negotiate with the remaining qualified proponent. This did not resolve the auditor’s separate concerns about proceeding with one bidder.

title: Gross service payments, contract terms, and owner-level proceeds remain unverified
summary: Public financial statements and the Auditor General examination do not disclose total gross service payments to DynaLIFE under the expanded 2022 agreement, the executed contract text or board-condition check, or the legal cash payee and owner-level distribution of the $31.5 million acquisition consideration.
attribution: Auditor General of Alberta; AHS audited 2023–24 financial statements
